column1: # Example query methylomes from zhou-lab/methscope_data, at the tag in TAGS.
# The one source in this catalog that ships DATA rather than annotation: small
# real .cg files to run a command against. Everything else here describes CpGs
# (orderings, coordinates, feature sets); nothing else gives you a methylome to
# point a command at, which left every example in the documentation either
# hypothetical or dependent on a file the reader had to supply.
# Layout upstream is flat under test/: {SHA256SUMS, *.cg, *.cg.idx}. The target
# is written "<genome>/data" so the browser files these under the genome's unit
# beside its KYCG sets, rather than inventing a unit of its own -- they are hg38
# files and belong where hg38 is.
